determinism: Real NewClient and Buffer.Pack construct actual sequence state. Immutable constructor hooks park data workers before Run, and synctest.Wait forces the real capacity wait. No provider, SDK, ACK-policy, physical rig, route or socket fixture is needed.
fix: On a rejected SendPack or ForwardPack, return the caller cancellation error before the buffer retries by retiring its shared sequence. Successful admissions and live-caller true sequence-closure recovery are unchanged.
history: The earlier v3 policy comparison used an ACK fixture for send roots. This matched standalone supplement removes that dependency while preserving names and ownership assertions; all earlier outcomes remain separately archived.
outcomes: Before6P18F; after24P0F; after-adjacent24P0F. All race=true, zero race warnings.
pooled_ownership: Failed calls retain caller bytes. Accepted sibling buffers are checked exactly and released by explicit consumer or joined sequence cleanup. Existing pool-boundary reconciliation covers all roots.
retention: Original sources, binaries, logs, commands and local paths remain immutable outside Git, represented by hashes.
roots: Each buffer has separate roots for initial caller cancellation, cancellation during full two-slot admission, and preservation of that caller's previously accepted Pack. Each has a positive true-closure replacement control.
